_about: The period tree of the one timeline (CWVault/claude/Prompt-Build-One-Timeline.md, lane B; Michael's periods of 8 Oct 2026, ruled 9 Oct: Rulings-Sept-2026.md, The one timeline). Times are millions of years ago (ma); 'from' is the older end. Each period: its name, a 'short' name for a narrow segment, 'knownFrom' (one line saying what that stretch is known from, the fog in words), 'colour' (after Hazen's sequence, drawn as a quiet tint on the line), and its 'chunks', the periods inside it. The 5 % rule (a segment narrower than about five percent of its line is not a period) holds everywhere but the last rung: After the ice is 4 % of Our kind and stays, because it is the door to the Time Machine (Michael). The six chunks of 6 Oct cut where the evidence changed kind; these cut where the story changes, and keep the evidence in the knownFrom lines. The root reaches 4568 so the oldest grains (4567.3) draw. Events are not here: stories/deep-time-events.json holds every event, and js/deep-time.js draws on each line the events whose age falls in its span. Read by js/deep-time.js.
name: Earth
knownFrom: everything below, each stretch from what survived of it

chunks.name: The young Earth
chunks.knownFrom: a few zircon grains, some moon rocks and meteorites; nothing else survived

chunks.name: First life
chunks.knownFrom: the oldest surviving rock, four billion years old; the first stromatolites; iron that stayed dissolved in a sea with no oxygen

chunks.name: Oxygen arrives
chunks.knownFrom: banded iron and red beds: rock that records oxygen arriving in the air

chunks.name: Ancestors
chunks.knownFrom: a few fossils of single cells, then of cells with nuclei; glacial rubble in rocks that sat at the equator, and the limestone laid on top of it

chunks.name: Animals
chunks.knownFrom: fossils hard enough to keep; from 200 million years the seafloor's magnetic stripes; at the end, ice that counts the years

chunks.name: In the sea
chunks.knownFrom: the first fossils of bodies, soft ones kept under volcanic ash, then shells and the first hard parts

chunks.name: On land
chunks.knownFrom: fossils of plants and animals in rock laid down on land, and coal; rock magnetism for how far north the land was, never how far east

chunks.name: The dinosaurs
chunks.knownFrom: fossils, and from 200 million years the seafloor's magnetic stripes, so the map is crisp

chunks.name: After the dinosaurs
chunks.knownFrom: fossils, then ice cores and sea-floor mud that count the years

chunks.name: Humans
chunks.knownFrom: fossil bones and footprints, stone tools, and the sea-floor mud that counts the years

chunks.name: The ice ages
chunks.knownFrom: ice cores, sea-floor mud, and the sea's old shorelines

chunks.name: Our kind
chunks.knownFrom: bones, beads, paint and tools; radiocarbon for the last fifty thousand years

chunks.name: After the ice
chunks.knownFrom: ice cores by the year, tree rings, and what people wrote
